**Install**: download `Calepin-….zip` below, unzip it, and follow the [Install](https://github.com/Calepin-app/Calepin#install) section of the README (LM Studio, Python, then double-click the launcher). No coding needed.

**Try it first** without installing: the [online demo](https://calepin-app.github.io/Calepin/).

A small personal tool, written almost entirely by Claude (Anthropic's AI) under my direction.

- Reads CSV exports from any bank: a local LLM works out each format once, then plain Python takes over.
- Files every transaction into your own category tree (GnuCash style, with assets and liabilities).
- Review page: checks, splits, comments, rules, sortable columns, an assistant you can talk to.
- Report: flows by category, recurring payments, month-by-month table, PDF export, copy to Excel.
- English or French. Nothing leaves your computer.

Known limits: developed and tested on macOS only; the Windows and Linux launchers have never been run. Reports welcome.
